description: Machine-readable specification for the INIT scripted generator. SKILL.md references this file; never restate its contents in prose. Single source of truth for what the generator produces.

invariants.copied_scripts_are_self_contained: Artifacts of type 'copy' under scripts/ are copied into governed projects FILE BY FILE. Each one must therefore run standalone: Node builtins only, no relative require() of sibling modules, no reads of skill-repo files. Extracting shared helpers into a library breaks every governed project unless the library is added here too - and even then it burdens each project with an implicit dependency. Duplication across these scripts is deliberate, not an oversight. Enforced by the 'payload:' tests in tests/run-tests.js (static invariant + end-to-end load check).

artifacts.content:
# .governance/ — machine-readable governance state

- `manifest.json` — desired state: declared artifacts, paths, versions. Git-tracked.
- `state.json` — current state: maturity, phase, agent identity. Git-tracked.
- `git-policy.json` — Git workflow policy (protected branches, direct push, review). Git-tracked.
- `sync-rules.json` — sync groups declaration (watch/require pairs). Git-tracked.
- `preflight.json` — pre-INIT snapshot (rollback basis). Git-tracked.
- `validation.json` / `drift-report.json` / `release-proposal.json` / `activity.jsonl` / `consent.json` — runtime outputs, git-ignored.

Usage: see the project AGENTS.md and `docs/rules/`.
artifacts.description: Explains each state file and git tracking strategy
Desired state: declared artifacts (generated last, lists only artifacts that exist on disk)
Current state (maturity, phase, agent identity, optional rule-capture candidates)
Pre-INIT snapshot with empty fields - agent fills after Phase 0 inspection (rollback basis)
Git workflow policy (JSON extracted from template code block)
Sync groups declaration (JSON extracted from template code block)
Generated sub-skills (agent-driven until the generator implements them)
Opt-in staged-content consistency hook (core.hooksPath is never configured by INIT)
Opt-in confirmed commit-message hook paired with pre-commit
